sources.title: Evaluation of Code LLMs on Geospatial Code Generation
sources.snippet: We categorised geospatial tasks based on their complexity and required tools. Then, we created a dataset with tasks that test model capabilities in spatial reasoning, spatial data processing, and geospatial tools usage. The dataset consists of specific coding problems that were manually created for high quality.
